messages.部分旧版内容未迁移: Some legacy items were not migrated
messages.迁移已停止，已完成的内容会保留。仍有分类或 Mod 未处理，可重新检查后继续迁移: Migration stopped. Completed items are kept. Some categories or mods remain unprocessed; review the contents again to continue.
messages.先关闭此窗口，在游戏页添加或选择游戏，再打开迁移。: Close this window, add or select a game on the Games page, then reopen migration.
messages.旧版文件不会更改；已存在的 Mod 不会重复导入。新导入的 Mod 暂不启用。: Legacy files stay unchanged. Existing mods are not imported again. Newly imported mods stay disabled.
messages.选择文件夹，或粘贴文件夹路径: Choose a folder or paste its path
messages.选择旧版 d3dxSkinManage.exe 所在的文件夹，不是 Mod 文件: Choose the folder containing the old d3dxSkinManage.exe, not your Mod folder.
messages.选择要迁移的旧版游戏数据: Choose the legacy game data to migrate
messages.请选择一份旧版游戏数据: Choose one set of legacy game data
messages.这份 Mod 的文件有修改。要保留旧版中的修改，请选择“修改后的文件”。: This Mod may have edited files. Choose “Edited files” to keep changes made in the legacy app.
messages.原始文件已丢失，将使用旧版解压后的文件。文件可能不完整，迁移后请检查。: The original files are missing. Extracted legacy files will be used instead. They may be incomplete; check the Mod after migration.
messages.把旧版 Mod 和整理信息带到当前游戏。: Bring legacy mods and their information into the current game.
messages.检查列表后点击“开始迁移”。现在还没有导入任何文件。: Review the list, then select “Start migration”. No files have been imported yet.
messages.请保持窗口打开。需要中断时可以停止，已完成的内容会保留。: Keep this window open. You can stop if needed; completed items will be kept.
messages.已导入的内容保存在当前游戏中，旧版文件仍保留。: Imported items are saved in the current game. Your legacy files are preserved.
messages.读取失败。请检查所选文件夹及文件访问权限，然后重新尝试。: Could not read the data. Check the selected folder and file access permissions, then try again.
messages.来源已更改。点击“检查迁移内容”更新列表后再迁移。: The source has changed. Select “Review contents” to update the list before migrating.
messages.选择文件夹后会自动识别旧版数据。: Legacy data is detected automatically after you choose a folder.
messages.已找到旧版数据。点击“检查迁移内容”继续。: Legacy data found. Select “Review contents” to continue.
messages.找到多份旧版数据，请选择本次要迁移的一份。: Multiple sets of legacy data found. Choose the one you want to migrate.
messages.没有找到旧版数据。请选择旧版程序所在的文件夹，不是 Mod 文件夹。: No legacy data found. Choose the folder containing the legacy app, not the Mod folder.
messages.没有可迁移的内容。可以返回上一步，检查文件夹或选择其他游戏数据。: Nothing to migrate. Go back to check the folder or choose another set of game data.
messages.注意事项中的未迁移条目不会导入；列表中的其他内容可以继续迁移。: Items marked “Not migrated” will not be imported. Other items in the list can still be migrated.
messages.要更换游戏，请关闭此窗口并在游戏页切换。: To change games, close this window and switch on the Games page.
messages.部分内容未完成。可重试未完成项；缺少文件等问题需修复后重新检查。: Some items are unfinished. You can retry them. Fix missing files or other source issues, then check again.
messages.本次可迁移内容已处理。仍有注意事项，请查看详情；未迁移条目不会自动补导入。: Eligible items have been processed. Review the remaining notes in the details. Excluded items are not imported automatically.
messages.本次内容已处理完成。到游戏的 Mod 列表中检查并启用需要的 Mod。: All items in this batch have been processed. Check them in the game's Mod list and enable the mods you want.
messages.把 d3dxSkinManage 的 Mod、分类和整理信息导入当前游戏，保留原: Import Mods, categories and their information from d3dxSkinManage into the current game while preserving the source files.
messages.迁移已中断，处理中项目的最终结果请以宿主资源库和任务中心为准。: Migration was interrupted. Check the host library and task center for the final outcome of items still being processed.
messages.预览旧版本地资源，将 Mod、分类、元数据和预览图复制到当前游戏。: Preview local legacy data and copy mods, categories, metadata, and previews into the current game.
messages.选择旧版安装目录，读取可迁移的用户环境。: Choose the legacy installation folder to find its user environments.
messages.请先选择旧版安装目录。: Choose the legacy installation folder first.
messages.扫描已停止，可以重新扫描。: Scanning stopped. You can scan again.
messages.选择一个旧版环境，然后扫描预览。: Choose a legacy environment, then scan it for a preview.
messages.未找到旧版环境，请选择包含 home 文件夹的旧版安装目录。: No legacy environments were found. Choose the legacy installation folder containing the home folder.
messages.请先在游戏页创建并选择目标游戏。: Create and select the target game on the Games page first.
messages.扫描未返回有效结果，请重新扫描。: The scan did not return a valid result. Scan again.
messages.请检查预览和扫描问题，确认后开始复制。: Review the preview and scan issues, then confirm to start copying.
messages.目标游戏已更改，旧任务已停止。请重新扫描后再复制。: The target game changed and the previous task stopped. Scan again before copying.
messages.上级分类创建失败。: The parent category could not be created.
messages.目标分类创建失败。: The target category could not be created.
messages.操作结果不属于当前目标游戏，复制已停止。: The operation result belongs to a different game. Copying stopped.
messages.宿主未返回导入结果。: The host did not return an import result.
messages.迁移记录无法保存，重试时将重新核对文件内容。: Migration history could not be saved. File contents will be checked again when retrying.
messages.正在停止，请等待当前项目完成安全处理…: Stopping. Waiting for the current item to reach a safe stopping point…
messages.复制已停止，已完成的项目会保留。: Copying stopped. Completed items are preserved.
messages.本次复制已结束，可在当前游戏中查看结果。: Copying has finished. Review the results in the current game.
messages.将旧版的本地 Mod、分类和整理信息复制到当前游戏。: Copy local mods, categories, and metadata from the legacy app into the current game.
messages.只复制本地资源，保留旧版文件。新导入的 Mod 保持停用，部署目录、加载器快捷键: Copies local resources and preserves legacy files. Imported mods stay disabled. Deployment paths, loader hotkeys, and legacy app settings are excluded.
messages.目标为游戏页当前选择的游戏；可先在游戏页创建或切换目标。: The target is the game currently selected on the Games page. Create or switch games there first if needed.
messages.旧版安装目录（包含 home 和 resources）: Legacy installation folder (containing home and resources)
messages.读取后选择旧版用户环境: Find and select a legacy user environment
messages.无法读取旧版文件或目录: The legacy file or folder could not be read.
messages.路径越过旧版目录或包含链接，已跳过: The path leaves the legacy folder or contains a link and was skipped.
messages.旧版 JSON 含重复字段，已跳过文件: The legacy JSON contains duplicate fields. The file was skipped.
messages.旧版索引或配置格式无效，已跳过文件: The legacy index or configuration has an invalid format. The file was skipped.
messages.旧版索引目录不存在: The legacy index folder is missing.
messages.获取地址格式或变量无效，已跳过该地址: The download address has an invalid format or variable and was skipped.
messages.旧版索引 SHA 无效，已跳过: The legacy index has an invalid SHA value and was skipped.
messages.旧版索引键无效，已跳过: The legacy index key is not a safe filename and was skipped.
messages.同一索引键的元数据冲突，已跳过: Indexes with the same key contain conflicting metadata and were skipped.
messages.Mod 来源已变化，请重新扫描: The Mod source has changed. Scan it again.
messages.旧版 Mod 元数据无效，已跳过: The legacy Mod metadata is invalid and was skipped.
messages.同名缩略图存在歧义，已跳过: Multiple thumbnails share this name. The ambiguous thumbnail was skipped.
messages.旧版缩略图资源不存在或格式不受支持: The legacy thumbnail is missing or uses an unsupported format.
messages.无法识别旧版缩略图指令，已跳过: The legacy thumbnail instruction was not recognized and was skipped.
messages.旧版缩略图匹配方式不受支持，仅使用精确匹配: The legacy thumbnail matching mode is unsupported. Only exact matches are used.
messages.已按旧版规则近似匹配缩略图，请检查结果: The thumbnail was approximately matched using legacy rules. Check the result.
messages.对象匹配多个旧版分类，已跳过相关 Mod: The object matches multiple legacy categories. Its mods were skipped.
messages.旧版分类规则无法完整读取，已跳过相关 Mod: The legacy classification rules could not be read completely. Affected mods were skipped.
messages.旧版包含多个获取地址，仅保留首个有效地址: The legacy entry contains multiple download addresses. Only the first valid address is kept.
messages.获取配置包含不支持的方式或参数，仅保留地址: The download configuration contains unsupported methods or options. Only its address is kept.
messages.同一 SHA 的索引元数据冲突，已跳过: Indexes with the same SHA contain conflicting metadata and were skipped.
messages.多个索引包含相同 Mod，已合并重复项: Multiple indexes contain the same Mod. Duplicate entries were combined.
messages.索引包含无法迁移的扩展字段: The index contains extra fields that cannot be migrated.
messages.旧版 Mod 本体缺失，仅有索引或解压缓存: The Mod resource is missing; only an index or an unusable extracted cache remains.
messages.所选目录不是旧版安装目录: The selected folder is not a legacy installation folder.
messages.无法读取旧版用户环境目录: The legacy user environment folder could not be read.
messages.旧版用户环境路径无效: The legacy user environment path is invalid.
messages.相同 Mod 的停用索引已跳过，保留启用索引信息: Disabled indexes for the same Mod were skipped. Active index metadata is kept.
messages.停用索引没有本地原包，已跳过: The disabled index has no local original archive and was skipped.
messages.停用索引的本地原包已纳入迁移: The disabled index's local original archive is included for migration.
messages.存在多个解压缓存，无法确定恢复来源，已忽略缓存: Multiple extracted caches were found. The recovery source is ambiguous, so the caches were ignored.
messages.解压缓存无效或包含链接，已忽略缓存: The extracted cache is invalid or contains links and was ignored.
messages.缓存与原包不同或无法确认一致，可选择恢复缓存修改: The cache differs from the original archive, or their equality cannot be verified. You can choose to recover cache changes.
messages.原包缺失，将恢复解压缓存；缓存可能不完整，请检查结果: The original archive is missing. The extracted cache will be recovered, but may be incomplete. Check the result.
messages.无法读取旧版预览图，已跳过: The legacy preview image could not be read and was skipped.
messages.无法识别原包格式: The original archive format could not be recognized.
messages.原包成员校验信息不完整: The original archive's member verification data is incomplete.
messages.选择 Mod 可检查原包与缓存来源。: Select a Mod to inspect its original archive and cache sources.
messages.缓存与原包不同或无法确认一致，可选择保留缓存修改。: The cache differs from the original archive, or their equality cannot be verified. You can choose to keep cache changes.
messages.原包缺失，将恢复缓存；缓存可能不完整。: The original archive is missing. The cache will be recovered, but may be incomplete.
messages.默认使用原包；缓存恢复不会修改旧版文件。: The original archive is used by default. Cache recovery does not modify legacy files.
messages.迁移报告无法生成或打开，请查看窗口中的结果。: The migration report could not be created or opened. Review the results in this window.
messages.复制保留旧版文件；新导入的 Mod 保持停用。: Copying preserves legacy files; newly imported mods stay disabled.
messages.目标游戏已有相同 Mod，保留现有数据，不重复导入。: The target game already contains the same Mod. Existing data is preserved; the Mod is not imported again.
messages.没有匹配的内容，清空搜索可查看全部。: No matching contents. Clear the search to see everything.
messages.选中条目查看详情: Select an item to see its details
messages.点击分类或 Mod 可查看信息；有旧版修改时，可在这里选择要保留的文件。: Select a category or Mod to view its information. If legacy edits are available, choose which files to keep here.
messages.预览图无法显示，迁移内容不受影响。: The preview image could not be displayed. Migration contents are unaffected.
messages.没有可迁移的内容。: There are no contents to migrate.
messages.角色或对象节点，不包含普通分类和 Mod。: Character or subject nodes, excluding regular categories and Mods.
messages.普通分类节点，不重复计入角色或对象。: Regular category nodes. Characters and subjects are counted separately.
messages.无法确定归属的条目仅在此展示，不会自动分配分类或加入迁移。: Items without a clear placement are displayed here only. No category is guessed and no import is added.
